eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Texas; at 7:26 PM on AUG 21, 2025 Effective until 7:26 PM AUG 22, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: AMBER Alert: Child Abduction from San Antonio, Texas. Suspect vehicle is a white Dodge Caravan with Texas license plate W F B 8 0 3 5. Missing child is Aurora Bojorquez, 3 year old white female. Suspect is Amber Heaviland, 38 year old white female. If seen call 9 1 1.
